tool_args.rationale: The five observations vary u_now and s_grad at a fixed horizon, providing adequate leverage for the four-parameter barrier-modulated siphon law; no listed probe addresses a remaining identifiability gap. The model fits the specified transformed flux plus square-root branch and estimates all parameters numerically.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed s_grad span is 2.0, far above the <0.08 condition specified for resolving the square-root branch; the existing data already include varied sink gradients.
That probe is for trajectory/memory ODE candidates; all rows have one horizon and the barrier-activated siphon is supported by the barrier-onset, base-field, and sink-gradient signatures.
These omit the observed sink-gradient dependence, and Michaelis-Menten is explicitly known to fail when s_grad varies.
